title: Formulas of Solids
content:
Basic formulas for the volume and surface area of common 3D shapes are frequently tested.

Type of SolidVolumeSurface Area
Cube$s^3$$6s^2$
Sphere$\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$$4\pi r^2$
Cone$\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$$\pi r l + \pi r^2$
Cylinder$\pi r^2 h$$2\pi r h$

Additional cube formulas: Face Diagonal = $s\sqrt{2}$, Body Diagonal = $s\sqrt{3}$.
summary: Basic formulas for the volume and surface area of common 3D shapes are frequently tested.
